heads: I bought my first property! Now what?!
post_manage_your_blog_from_your_live_sit.text: id="PAGES_CONTAINER" class="PAGES_CONTAINER" tabindex="-1" data-main-content="true"> All Posts Search I bought my first property! Now what?! Joseph Mills Jan 13, 2022 2 min read Updated: Mar 28, 2022 Getting started in real estate investing is exciting, but no one ever tells you the full truth of what comes next! Once the papers are signed and keys are handed over, there is still so much to do! Where do you start? 1. Find a tenant. Start with people you know. Do you know anyone that needs a place? Some people don’t want to rent to family, but maybe you have a distant acquaintance that you trust? If not, list the vacancy on a variety of sites including Facebook Marketplace, Craigslist, KSL, etc. Do you need to conduct interviews? What sort of research should I do on applicants? How do I do that research? All of these are excellent questions. Yes! Conduct interviews, especially if this is your first property. And yes, you need to do some research. At the very least, look up their credit score and call their employer to know if they are dependable. You don’t have to like the person, but you do need to trust them to follow through on their contract. For more information on how to choose the right tenant, check out our article all about it here ! 2. Sign the contract. Be sure to find a contract that protects you and your tenant. The importance of a detailed contract cannot be understated. Be sure there are provisions for damage, subletting, and pets. There should also be a detailed explanation of how and when rent should be collected, and what happens if it is late. One of our favorite free contracts is available through Law Depot . 3. Collect Rent. It sounds obvious, but it can be intimidating to hold people accountable. But since your contract made it clear how rent would be collected you can move forward comfortable. Follow the steps you forecasted and don’t be afraid to be strict. Remember you got this! Once you get the ball rolling there will be no stopping your winning streak through passive income. We are excited for you! Now if managing your property starts to feel overwhelming, reach out! We offer a full service property management solution to take away all the headache but leave all the reward! Welcome to the Real Estate Investment Club!

commercial_real_estate.text: id="PAGES_CONTAINER" class="PAGES_CONTAINER" tabindex="-1" data-main-content="true"> Utah Commercial Real Estate Investments Brokerage & Portfolio Management Full-service brokerage servicing the Salt Lake City metropolitan area since 2008. Our core clients include high net worth investors, family offices, corporate tenants, private equity, & sponsors in the Utah market. ​ We offer representation in: ​​ Direct Real Estate Allocations Strategic Wealth growth 1031 Exchange & Tax Strategy Asset Preservation Value-add Operations & Asset Stabilization Looking to invest in the Wasatch Front? Our commercial brokers & team assist in buying, selling, property management, leasing, filling occupancy, value-add, development, 1031 exchange, building real estate portfolios, financial analysis, and price opinions. ​ IRA transacted on over $103M in volume in 2021. Our capable team assists with site selection, strategic real estate growth planning, relocation, build-to-suit, buying, leasing, renewals, facility operations, selling, buy vs lease analysis, and sale vs leaseback analysis. Get a Quote Areas We Specialize In Investors & Owner/User Looking to buy, sell, or lease a commercial asset? IRA offers representation in purchasing, operating, selling & leasing investment and corporate assets, servicing investors, owner/users, corporate tenants & franchisees. Read More 1031 Exchange ​ ​ IRA is vastly experienced in representing the brokerage component of 1031 transactions on both the "up leg" in selling the relinquished property, and the "down leg" of securing & closing on exchange property. Read More Value-Add & Development IRA is vastly experienced in representing the brokerage component of 1031 transactions on both the "up leg" in selling the relinquished property, and the "down leg" of securing & closing on exchange property. Read More Full Service Solution ​ IRA is a Salt Lake organically grown brokerage & team with $380M+ of assets under management in Utah. Our services include sales, leasing property management, consulting, reporting, and financials analysis. Read More Value Add & Development Our experts provide full development services from the conceptual design stage through construction, operation, and exit. ​ We pride ourselves on our strong relationships within The Greater Salt Lake area, on understanding local building codes, and on our goal to improve our State by developing remarkable communities. We understand the market and how to source deals, and constantly work to meet all investment mandates of JV Partners & clients. ​​ IRA and its partners offer substantial experience in design/architecture, financing, equity, entitlements, construction management, and property management. IRA and its partners are always looking for strategic capital partners, private equity, and JV relationships with family offices, high net-worth individuals, or funds. IRA Preferred Development Partner & Associate Company Learn More Development 1031 Exchange IRS tax code 1031 provides guidelines for sellers to 1031 exchange into other "like-kind" real estate under very specific guidelines, to defer paying capital gains tax and depreciation recapture on the sale. We represent clients through the process of selling relinquished property, identifying exchange properties, closing, and coordinating with the client's 1031 accommodator. ​ The IRS tax code is structured to give individuals incentives to do things for the government and community, which the government cannot do itself. Therefore, to motivate investors to purchase, hold, and improve properties, the IRS offers the tax shelter of depreciation and bonus depreciation. The government likes real estate transactions in the economy, thereby the 1031 Exchange was created to defer the tax burden to investors, allowing them to roll into equal or greater "like-kind" properties. This defers the capital gains tax being paid on the sale, thereby allowing the tax savings to be reinvested with the profits into the next property. In turn, this encourages investors to leverage up in value multiple times, over a lifetime, for continued depreciation benefits. Get Started 1031 Fully Managed Solutions Investing in real estate is exciting! But there is a lot more than just touring the property and finding the funds, not to mention what comes after you close. At Investment Realty Advisors we are here to support you, we have the capacity to run the operation for you, thus allowing you to truly enjoy passive income. Our brokers can start with finding the deal, negotiating terms, closing the deal, and our property management team handles everything afterward. We have a strategic partnership with Affinity Construction to take care of any rehabilitation or remodeling needs you may have. Reap all the rewards without having to manage all the headaches! benefits.title: Tenant Benefits | Investment Realty Advisors | Utah
benefits.meta: As a tenant with Investment Realty Advisors, we are happy to offer you benefits to protect you. These benefits include renters insurance, air filters, home buying assistance, etc.
benefits.text: id="PAGES_CONTAINER" class="PAGES_CONTAINER" tabindex="-1" data-main-content="true"> Resident Benefits Package Investment Realty Advisors is happy to provide our tenants with our Resident Benefits Package. For $45/month, our residents receive the following benefits: Resident Liability Insurance As part of the Resident Benefits Package, you are enrolled in Asset Protection. Your lease agreement requires all residents to maintain liability insurance. However, this benefits package waives your obligation to indemnify the property owner for accidental damages (fire, smoke, explosion, water discharge, sewer backup, pet damage, and bed bug remediation) caused by negligent acts or omissions, as further described in your lease agreement up to $100,000. Asset Protection is not a renter’s insurance policy and is not designed to replace a renter’s insurance policy. Home Buying Assistance Almost ready to move from renting to homeownership? In partnership with our brokerage, our team of professional Realtors will help guide you throughout the process and help you find your perfect home as part of this package. Air Filter Delivery Your air filter collects dust, hair, dander, and other particles that get circulated through the air system. Changing your home’s air filter ensures your home has cleaner, healthier, and fresher air. It also helps you save money on your heating and cooling bills! The Resident Benefits Package makes it easier than ever to replace them! Investment Realty Advisors will deliver an air filter right to your door every 90 days. There is no need for you to remember or buy one, it is hassle-free, and all you will have to do is change them out! 24/7 Maintenance Coordination We’re ready to solve your midnight emergencies! Reporting any maintenance request requiring immediate action is easy and fast through our 24/7 emergency maintenance line available to our residents. Emergency maintenance requests consist of fire, flooding, sewer backup, and exposed wiring. In the case of an emergency, call (801) 528-4557 ext. #5 during business hours and ext. #2 after hours and on holidays. Please relay your name, property address, and the issue to the agent. If your issue requires immediate action, our maintenance coordinators will contact you shortly after the request is reported. Online Resident Portal View any charges on your ledger, make online payments, submit work orders, and access your communications through our online resident portal. All you have to do is visit our Tenant Portal & FAQ page on this website, and create a login. It’s that easy! Free ACH Online Payments: Online payments are fast and convenient, but why pay extra? Our online Resident Portal allows you to make ACH payments with no convenience fee charged to you! And yes, it gets even better by allowing you to set up monthly auto-payments. *Credit and Debit card payments will still be charged a convenience fee to the resident.* 1X Late Fee Forgiveness It happens to the best of us; sometimes, life takes over. And during those times, it's easy to forget to pay rent on time. During your tenancy, you will receive the benefit of 1 late fee forgiveness through the Resident Benefits Package if rent is paid in full within three days after rent is deemed late. 1X Evaluation Rescheduling To ensure the property is being well-maintained, we conduct regular property inspections. There is a $50 fee for canceling and rescheduling a previously scheduled inspection as listed in the lease agreement. However, through the Resident Benefit Package, we grant you the option to cancel and reschedule one inspection once throughout your tenancy without being charged the fee. One of the lease signers will need to request a reschedule no later than 24 hours before the scheduled appointment. Vetted Vendor Network We only work with reputable, licensed, and insured vendors for every job. This ensures we have the best possible vendors servicing our properties for your peace of mind.

sellerfinance.title: Seller Finance | Investment Realty Advisors | Utah
sellerfinance.meta: Click here for additional information for all seller financing needs.
heads: What happens if my buyer defaults?
What should I consider as a seller in this market
sellerfinance.text: id="PAGES_CONTAINER" class="PAGES_CONTAINER" tabindex="-1" data-main-content="true"> Seller Finance Seller financing is a financing arrangement in which the seller of a property agrees to finance all or part of the purchase price for the buyer. In this arrangement, the buyer makes payments directly to the seller, rather than to a traditional lender like a bank. ​ The terms of seller financing are negotiable and can vary depending on the needs of the buyer and the seller. Typically, the buyer pays a down payment to the seller and then makes regular payments, including principal and interest, over an agreed-upon period of time. The seller may hold a mortgage on the property as collateral until the buyer has paid off the loan in full. ​ Seller financing can be beneficial for both buyers and sellers. For buyers, it provides an alternative financing option if they are unable to secure financing through traditional lenders. For sellers, it can help attract more buyers and sell their property more quickly, as well as potentially earn a higher overall return on their investment. ​ It's important to note that seller financing does come with some risks for both parties, including the risk of default and the need for a thorough legal agreement to protect both parties' interests. It's always a good idea to consult with a real estate attorney or financial advisor before entering into any financing arrangement. ​ How do I set up automatic payments? ​ Setting up fee's is easy Escrow Specialist Fee's What happens if my buyer defaults? If a buyer defaults on their payments in a seller financing arrangement, the seller may have several options depending on the terms of the agreement and applicable state laws. ​ One option is to work with the buyer to establish a payment plan or modify the terms of the agreement to help them catch up on missed payments. This can be a good option if the buyer has experienced a temporary financial setback but is committed to fulfilling their obligations under the agreement. ​ If the buyer is unwilling or unable to make the necessary payments, the seller may have the right to foreclose on the property and repossess it. This process typically requires a court order and can be time-consuming and costly. Alternatively, the seller may be able to work out a deed in lieu of foreclosure, in which the buyer voluntarily transfers ownership of the property back to the seller. ​ It's important to note that the specific options available to a seller in the event of a default will depend on the terms of the agreement and applicable state laws. To minimize the risk of default, sellers should conduct a thorough evaluation of the buyer's financial position and creditworthiness before entering into a seller financing agreement, and may also consider requiring a larger down payment or shorter repayment period to mitigate their risk. What should I consider as a seller in this market If you're a seller considering seller financing, here's a checklist of things to consider: Financial position of the buyer: Before entering into a seller financing agreement, it's important to evaluate the buyer's financial position and creditworthiness to ensure that they will be able to make the necessary payments. Down payment: Consider requiring a significant down payment from the buyer to reduce your risk and ensure that the buyer has a financial stake in the property. Interest rate: Decide on an interest rate that is fair and competitive, and that takes into account the level of risk involved in the transaction. Repayment period: Determine the length of the repayment period based on the buyer's financial position and your own needs and objectives. Payment schedule: Decide on a payment schedule that works for both you and the buyer, taking into account factors such as the buyer's income and expenses. Legal agreement: Work with a real estate attorney to draft a legal agreement that outlines the terms of the seller financing arrangement and protects both parties' interests. Title insurance: Consider requiring the buyer to purchase title insurance to protect against any potential legal issues with the property. Appraisal and inspection: Consider requiring an appraisal and inspection of the property to ensure that it is valued appropriately and in good condition. Exit strategy: Develop an exit strategy in case the buyer defaults on payments or other issues arise, and make sure it is included in the legal agreement. Tax implications: Consider the tax implications of seller financing and consult with a tax professional to ensure that you are in compliance with all relevant laws and regulations. By considering these factors and working with professionals such as real estate attorneys and tax professionals, you can help ensure a successful and secure seller financing transaction. Benefits of Seller Financing Attracting more buyers By offering seller financing, you can attract a wider pool of potential buyers who may not be able to secure traditional bank loans. This can increase your chances of finding a buyer and selling your property quickly. Higher sale price With seller financing, you may be able to negotiate a higher sale price for your property, as buyers are often willing to pay a premium for the flexibility and convenience of seller financing. Passive income As the lender in a seller financing arrangement, you'll earn passive income in the form of regular payments from the buyer. This can provide a steady stream of income and potentially higher overall returns than other investment options. Faster closing Seller financing transactions can often be closed more quickly and with less paperwork than traditional bank loans, allowing you to sell your property faster and with less hassle. portal.text: id="PAGES_CONTAINER" class="PAGES_CONTAINER" tabindex="-1" data-main-content="true"> TENANT PORTAL Click Here to Log In Welcome to IRA Management We are glad you are here! Tenant Portal Submit maintenance request, pay rent online, access records, etc. Renter FAQ's Answers to frequently asked questions below Residential Listings Search our available residential space units. Commercial Listings Contact Us Commercial, Office, Retail, Industrial, & Other Other questions? FAQs & Contact us below! FAQ R E N T E R F A Q ' S How do i pay rent? Rent can be paid by mailing or dropping off a check or money order to The UPS store 869 E 4500 S PMB#224 SLC, UT 84107. Please make sure your payment clearly states your name and property address. Online payments are also an option. How much is the security deposit? A security deposit is protection for the owner against any property damage caused by the resident during occupancy. We hold your deposit until you move out, removing any resident caused damages. The refundable security deposit will be mailed to the last known address within 30 days of move out. Security Deposit amount based on background check. What if I pay rent late? We are happy to waive one late fee, we understand that things happen. Late fee and past due date are listed in your lease agreement. Reach out to Tenant Relations with any question. Are pets allowed? We love all our furry and non-furry friends! But only some properties are pet-friendly. Please check the listing or ask to be sure that the property you are interested in is pet-friendly. How long is a lease? We offer 12 month/ 1-year leases. ​ Other options are sometimes available upon request. Is the space furnished? Some of our listings are fully furnished, some are a blank canvas ready for you to input your personality. Check the listing or ask the listing agent for more information. I want to move before my contract ends? We want you to be happy. Please come talk to us about your situation so we can find the best possible solution for you and our landlords. Is there an application fee? Yes, there is a $25.00 application fee for all applicants 18 years and older. ALL adults must fill out an application and sign the lease. We will be running a credit and background check. What is The Renter Benefits Package? Our Benefits Package is designed to protect you and provide valuable services. Some of these services include improving your credit score, delivering air filters, and liability waivers. How do you manage maintenance requests? For issues of plumbing, appliances, or heating and cooling please fill out a maintenance request through the tenant portal immediately. ​ We will dispatch a professional to fix the problem as soon as we can keeping in mind there are other, maybe more pressing, requests, too. Are utilities included? Depending on the space, utilities are included in the rent price, but not always. If you are unsure, please check the listing or ask the listing agent for more information. Have a different question? Please email us through the contact form below or call this phone number: 801-528-4557x We hope you are happy in your home! Thanks for being a part of Investment Reality Advisors. Send Thanks! We will get back to you soon. Contact Us Have a question? Shoot us a note!
